messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-jamie and #incidents — dedicated pool 'zephyr-systems-prod' GPU utilization 98-100% for 8m, request queue latency >1200ms. Auto-threshold breached.
oncall-jamie: Ack, grabbing context. @sre-miguel can you triage?
sre-miguel: Looking now. KV-cache miss spike coincides with a flurry of long-running interactive sessions. One tenant (zephyr-systems) currently occupying ~85% of GPUs.
acct-srobinson: Heads-up — Zephyr is on enterprise reserved plan with SLA 99.9%. Their CSM just pinged me.
support-ellen: Support seeing customer errors: frontend snapshot shows ~30% 503s on /model/generate for Zephyr traffic.
eng-runtime: Options: 1) emergency burst to shared hotpool (if enabled) — ~2-6 min attach. 2) spin extra dedicated nodes — ~6-8 min. 3) degrade model for Zephyr to a smaller quantized variant (gpt-7b-q4) to reduce memory and parallelism needs immediately.
oncall-jamie: Quick ask — what's risk of evicting non-critical tenants to free GPUs?
sre-miguel: Eviction frees ~2 GPUs but will spike errors for evicted tenants (lower-tier). Prefer burst + model degrade for Zephyr first to avoid collateral. We have playbook for this.
acct-srobinson: I can approve emergency burst charge on the account. CSM confirmed Zephyr accepts overage for urgent mitigation.
eng-platform: Plan to execute: 1) enable emergency burst (attach shared-hotpool to zephyr-systems), 2) patch Zephyr route to use gpt-7b-q4 with fallback to gpt-13b, 3) enable aggressive batching and prefix cache priming. Running API calls now.
eng-platform: ```bash
# enable burst (internal API)
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/burst" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"tenant":"zephyr-systems","pool":"shared-hot","duration":"30m"}'

# patch route to smaller model
curl -X PATCH "https://console.redwood/api/v1/routes/zephyr-systems" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-7b-q4","fallback":"gpt-13b","max_tokens":512}'
```
oncall-jamie: Executing step 1 and 2 now. Standby for telemetry.
support-ellen: Error rate dropping from 30% -> 8% within ~2min after route change. :thumbsup:
sre-miguel: Monitoring queue length and GPU occupancy. Current GPU usage trending to 60-70% after changes. If it stays >85% in 10m we'll proceed with eviction of low-priority tenants.
customer-ops-lisa: (Zephyr) We're seeing latency improve — p95 down from ~1800ms to ~320ms. Thanks. Please keep us updated on rollback plan.
eng-runtime: Telemetry shows sustained reduction. We'll let burst run for 30m and monitor. We'll also create a follow-up to tune autoscale thresholds and reserved burst limits.
incident-bot: Incident updated — severity lowered as customer impact reduced. Logging actions and timestamps.
oncall-jamie: Marking this as hands-off to morning on-call for follow-up and postmortem. Creating ticket INV-2026-8421 to review autoscale policy, eviction thresholds, and playbook clarity. Closing live thread but will keep watch. :white_check_mark:
